# Galaxy Hunt

Super Star Trek, drawn with emoji. The galaxy is eight by eight. Destroy every raider before the stardate runs out.

## Start

Return leaves the title. R, when the mission ends, starts another and skips the title. `HELP` prints the rose and this list again. `QUIT` abandons the mission.

## Commands

Course is 1 to 9 around the compass rose. Warp is 0.1 to 8.

- `NAV` course warp
- `SRS` and `LRS` — the short-range map, the long-range map
- `BEA` energy — beams
- `MIS` course — a missile
- `SHE` energy — shields
- `DAM`, `COM`, `STA` — damage, the library computer, status

## The map

🚀 is you. 👾 is a raider. ⭐ is a star. 🏢 is an outpost. A dot is empty space.

Stars block you, and they block missiles. Dock by flying onto an outpost when the ship is falling apart. That resupplies and repairs you. Run out of energy, or out of time, and the mission fails.
